name: Vegas Showroom
description: Classic Vegas showroom: red velvet, gold, marquee bulb borders that chase and twinkle, rhinestone stripes, script and showbill type. A Tonight Only show open, a jukebox player card, a gold-record milestone graphic and a Show's Over end card. Every graphic type, plus basketball, football and hockey.
